comments.author: @super71x
comments.text: There are many great places to eat in Ensenada, but Guerrero is the biggest rip-off; he who doesn't know God will kneel before any saint.

comments.author: @nopaulogee
comments.text: Went to Ensanada back in 70s and 80s it was the place to go when you lived in San Diego.

comments.author: @JoseElPipian
comments.text: My first time at the Guerrerense was about 17 years ago and had the great opportunity of meeting the amazing and loveble Sabina, to me most carts are about equal because they provide super fresh seafood, but Sabina tops them all because she has the most unique and best salsas and if you know how to use them, they make all the difference. I am such a lucky dog....

comments.author: @geraldarnoult
comments.text: Mexico has the sea as a border. A fish on a tortilla? No way. Fish tacos were invented in Ensenada; they were eating them before Ensenada existed. It's a good selling point, though. Always enjoy your videos. live in Mexico and love it
